parity.check: Let's check the parity of both the number of tiles to place and the number of cells in the Area.

block.false: A simple road starting from a road entering the Area has its starting point on a black cell @m{false}.
block.true_false: A simple road connecting two roads entering the Area has endpoints of different colors @m{parity}.
block.false_false: A simple road connecting two roads entering the Area has both endpoints on black cells @m{false}.

region.true_true: A simple road connecting two roads entering the remaining region has both endpoints on white cells @m{true}.

To solve this Area, all you need to know is the rule that @g{rule/common/tile}{tiles can only be placed where their patterns match}.
